g.text: PMO onboarding v2 - target in the actual tenant (design, not built)
Private endpoint only: no public address. One stack per tenant (PEST, Vestacy). Same workflow and rules as the pilot.
and the worker: Entra, Graph, Azure,
- Hosting: Static Web Apps Free -> one App Service app (website + API, .NET 10).
- Access: public URL -> private endpoint only, private DNS, Conditional Access.
- Database: connection string -> keys off; app and worker use managed identities.
- Password and TAP mail: ACS -> Graph sendMail from one shared mailbox, encrypted by Purview.
- Deploys and admin tools: Cloud Shell with a key -> in-VNet build agent with Entra sign-in.
- Logs: console -> Application Insights and Log Analytics.
- Same: the workflow, the approvals, the agent's gated writes, tenant separation, the data model.
